#define MATCH_SHORT(op, op_limit, len, distance) {      \ /* <=== blosc/blosclz.c:348:353:MATCH_SHORT:4 */

    goto out;                                           \

}

  if (BLOSCLZ_UNLIKELY(op + 1 > op_limit))              \

    goto out;                                           \

}
